question: Estimate the number of pilgrims at Tirupati (Tirumala Venkateswara temple) per year.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Direct from TTD (Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams) data.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: TTD reports daily pilgrim count: ~80,000-100,000 average day; ~150,000+ on weekends and Brahmotsavam festival days.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~3-3.5 crore (30-35 million) pilgrims per year.
